_comment: Target regions for partner sourcing. DERIVED FROM THE REAL FTC PUBLIC EVENT DATA (reference/events-sample.csv — the snapshot of the sibling feed-the-city-event-map's published Google Sheet). Each region is a metro that contains one or more real FTC events. bbox = [south, west, north, east] in WGS84. The fetch script (scripts/fetch-partners.mjs) queries the OpenStreetMap Overpass API once per region. Add regions here to expand coverage.
